page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor using the x86_64 CPU architecture. Powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, the server incorporates 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1024.0 GB of memory. This hardware allocation yields a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 8.0 GB of memory per individual vCPU core.

For networking and peripheral connectivity, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps without provisioned complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage drives, requiring all persistent data to be backed by remote block storage solutions. Discrete GPU hardware accelerators are also omitted from this configuration.

The combination of high memory density and 64 Gbps networking makes the ecs.r7.32xlarge structurally effective for memory-bound applications. Appropriate workload fits include large in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, enterprise resource planning platforms, and big data processing frameworks.
